next.name: Cobalt Strike
next.headline: Cobalt Strike: a 2021 analysis of a PowerShell loader with an XOR-encoded payload
next.in_short: One 2021 blog post analyses a PowerShell script identified as Cobalt Strike. It says a Base64 block is XOR-encoded and can be decoded with CyberChef. The post names no actor, sector, country or victim.

sentences.t: A blog post by Michael Koczwara, published on 6 September 2021, analyses a PowerShell payload identified as Cobalt Strike.
The author says they found the sample through a tweet from Malwar3Ninja.
According to the post, a Base64 block inside the PowerShell script is encrypted with XOR.
The post says the encoded payload can be extracted from the script and then decrypted with the CyberChef tool.
This profile rests on a single source. It does not say who used the sample, whom they targeted or where.
